A delegate is a volunteer representative elected by their neighbors at precinct caucus and BPOU conventions. Delegates serve as the voice of their community within their local Basic Political Organizing Unit (BPOU) and help guide party priorities, leadership, and endorsements.

What do Delegates do?
✔️ Attend BPOU meetings and conventions
✔️ Vote on local party leadership and rules
✔️ Help shape policy priorities and grassroots strategy
✔️ Support candidates and organize locally

Delegates play a critical role in making sure grassroots voices are heard - not just political insiders.

How do you become a delegate?
👉 Attend your precinct caucus on February 3rd
👉 Sign in and participate
👉 Volunteer or be nominated to serve as a delegate
👉 Be elected by your neighbors at caucus
👉 Be elected by your neighbors at the BPOU convention

It’s that simple - and it’s one of the most impactful ways to get involved in your community.
